security_audit.summary: All 35 static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown links, code fences, inline formatting, metadata URLs, or marketing terminology. No executable commands, network requests, path traversal operations, or prompt injection were found. The skill does direct agents to persist plans and update a shared memory file.

remediation.issue: The workflow writes campaign data to workspace memory and updates a shared hot-cache file.
remediation.suggestion: Request confirmation before writing, sanitize the topic filename, and merge shared memory updates without replacing unrelated content.

content.value_statement: Influencer campaigns often lack measurable goals, realistic budgets, and coordinated execution. This skill creates a complete strategy, timeline, creator mix, and KPI framework.
actual_capabilities: Captures brand, audience, budget, timeline, campaign type, and approval constraints.
Defines SMART objectives with measurable success and failure criteria.
Builds platform and creator-tier strategies with selection criteria and exclusions.
Specifies content deliverables, creative direction, disclosures, and approval stages.
Creates phased timelines and budget allocations by category, tier, and platform.
Sets KPI targets, attribution methods, reporting cadence, and campaign risks.
limitations: It does not discover or verify individual creators without external data.
It does not create contracts, negotiate fees, or send creator outreach.
Benchmarks depend on user inputs or optional analytics connectors.
It plans the creator channel, not the complete product launch program.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Product Launch
use_cases.description: Create the creator-channel strategy, budget, deliverables, timeline, and measurement plan for a new product.

use_cases.title: Design an Always-On Program
use_cases.description: Structure a recurring creator program with tier roles, content cadence, approval stages, and performance targets.

use_cases.title: Present a Campaign Blueprint
use_cases.description: Turn campaign requirements into a complete plan for stakeholder review, budget approval, and team handoff.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Campaign Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan an influencer campaign for [brand] promoting [product] to [audience] during [timeframe] with a [budget] budget.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when the core campaign inputs are available.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Launch Campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a creator campaign for [product launch]. Include objectives, platform roles, creator tiers, deliverables, timeline, budget, KPIs, and risks.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a product launch with influencer support.

prompt_templates.title: Restructure an Existing Campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Redesign this underperforming campaign using these results: [results]. Keep [constraints], revise the creator mix, budget, content, timeline, and KPI targets.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when past performance data and constraints are known.

prompt_templates.title: Develop a Multi-Platform Program
prompt_templates.prompt: Build an always-on creator program for [brand] across [platforms]. Define quarterly phases, tier economics, deliverable cadence, attribution, approvals, and optimization rules.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for advanced, recurring programs across several platforms.

output_examples.input: Plan a sustainable sneaker launch for Gen Z on TikTok and Instagram with a $50,000 budget.
output: Primary goal: generate 2.5 million qualified impressions and 1,500 tracked product-page visits within six weeks.
Creator mix: 20 micro creators and 35 nano creators focused on sustainable fashion and student lifestyles.
Budget: 60% creator fees, 15% product, 10% production, 10% amplification, and 5% contingency.

output_examples.input: Create an always-on creator program for a direct-to-consumer skincare brand.
output: Program structure: monthly education themes, quarterly product priorities, and recurring creator cohorts.
Measurement: engagement quality, tracked trials, repeat content performance, and attributed revenue.
Cadence: monthly reporting, quarterly creator reviews, and budget reallocation based on cost per trial.

output_examples.input: Improve a campaign with strong reach but weak sales conversion.
output: Shift budget toward high-intent micro creators with demonstrated product education performance.
Add tracked landing pages, unique creator codes, clearer calls to action, and weekly conversion reviews.
Define pause rules for placements that exceed the target cost per acquisition.

best_practices: Provide real budget, timing, audience, approval, and platform constraints before planning.
Use verified past performance or platform benchmarks when setting targets.
Review legal disclosures, claims, usage rights, and brand safety before execution.
anti_patterns: Do not leave placeholders in the approved campaign plan.
Do not select creators using follower count without audience and engagement checks.
Do not treat estimated reach or earned media value as guaranteed business results.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the brand, product, audience, campaign type, platforms, budget, dates, constraints, and approval requirements.

faq.question: Can this skill find specific influencers?
faq.answer: No. It defines selection criteria and tier mix, but creator discovery requires separate data or a discovery skill.

faq.question: Does it create individual creator briefs?
faq.answer: No. It creates the campaign blueprint that a brief-generation workflow can convert into individual briefs.

faq.question: Can it work without analytics connectors?
faq.answer: Yes. Supply benchmarks and past results directly, or accept clearly labeled planning assumptions.

faq.question: How are budgets allocated?
faq.answer: The plan divides budget by category, creator tier, and platform, then calculates CPM, CPE, and content cost targets.

faq.question: Does it manage the full product launch?
faq.answer: No. It covers the creator channel and should align with the broader launch calendar, press, community, and readiness plan.
